title: One repair pass over a response already judged invalid
description: A SECOND MODEL EVENT, recorded as its own call beside the original. The original response is preserved byte-for-byte and is never overwritten; repaired prose is never presented as the first answer. The repair is given the audit finding and the original structured response, and NOT the image — re-observation is a different operation and resending the picture would let the repair quietly become a second look. A repair that changes the wording while preserving the unsupported claim is still a failure, and the audit is re-run over the result to decide that rather than trusting the model's own report.

repaired_text.description: The offending field, rewritten. The audit is re-run over this and decides whether the repair worked.

removed.description: What was taken out, in the model's own words. Compared against the audit's matched span.

kept.description: The observation that survived. A repair that removes the unsupported number by deleting the whole observation has destroyed the useful part, and this field is what lets that be seen.

changed_meaning.description: The model's own report of whether the reading changed. Recorded, never trusted: the audit and a text diff decide.
